verdict.rationale: Rive is a design and animation editor, so managing design tokens or variables with modes or themes is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents a tokens or variables system, nor modes or themes applied across designs. Data binding and view models (connecting colors and layouts to real-time data) are a related runtime-data feature, not design-token management, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a designer, I can manage design tokens or variables — colors, spacing, typography — with modes or themes applied across designs
